archetypes.name: dyn-lint-ratchet
archetypes.rationale: New flat-test lint and Makefile wiring need path and enumeration scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new lint_flat_tests module and Makefile/CLI wiring. Focus on whether tracked and untracked python/test_*.py files at repo root are detected without flagging python/tests/** or the test_support.py helper. Check that relocated harness paths and run-relevant bg-wait routing still point to the new mirrored test paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
